devices.比喻: metaphor / simile: compares one thing to another (像, 如, 仿佛, 是)
devices.拟人: personification: gives human actions or feelings to things
devices.排比: parallelism: three or more phrases with the same structure, for rhythm and force
devices.反复: repetition: the same word or sentence repeated for emphasis or feeling
devices.对比: contrast: puts two opposite things side by side
devices.叠词: reduplication: doubled words (绿绿的, 慢慢地) for softness and vividness
devices.设问: asking a question and answering it yourself
devices.反问: rhetorical question: a question that really states a point
devices.通感: synesthesia: describes one sense in terms of another (a smell like a song)
devices.象征: symbolism: an object stands for an idea
devices.借物喻人: using an object to talk about how people should be
devices.呼告: speaking directly to a thing or absent person
devices.细节描写: close detail of an action or object that carries the emotion
devices.旧用法: older (1920s) usage that modern Chinese writes differently

oldUsage.底: In 1920s writing 底 is often used where modern Chinese writes 的 (我们底新花生 = 我们的新花生).
oldUsage.罢: Here 罢 = modern 吧 (sentence-final particle).
oldUsage.么: Here 么 at the end of a question = modern 吗.
oldUsage.那里: In older texts 那里 can mean 哪里 (where).
oldUsage.他: Older writing often uses 他 for things and animals too, where modern Chinese writes 它.
oldUsage.检: Here 检 = modern 捡 (to pick up).
oldUsage.嬴: Here 嬴 is used for 赢 (to win).
oldUsage.沈: Here 沈 = modern 沉 (to sink).
oldUsage.馀: 馀 = modern 余 (more than; 二年馀 = 两年多).
oldUsage.著: Here 著 = modern 着 (aspect particle).

intro: 雨后，一只翅膀湿了的蝉挣扎着爬上松树，又被雨珠打落。作者借小虫写生命的脆弱和命运的无常。
A cicada with rain-soaked wings climbs a pine and is knocked down again: a tiny scene about how fragile life is.

notes.q: 不老的松根
notes.zh: “不老”的松树和只活一个夏天的蝉形成对比。
notes.en: The ageless pine contrasts with the short-lived cicada.

notes.q: 雨珠，你和他开玩笑么？
notes.zh: 作者直接对雨珠说话，把雨珠当成人，表达对蝉的同情。
notes.en: The writer talks to the raindrop as if it were a person, showing pity for the cicada.

notes.q: 蚂蚁来了！野鸟也快要看见他了！
notes.zh: 危险一个接一个出现，短句和感叹号制造紧张感。
notes.en: Short exclamations pile up the dangers and build tension.

intro: 作者比较纸做的面具和人的脸：面具表情不变，人脸却会“装”。文章讽刺人的虚伪。
Paper masks never change their expression; human faces pretend. A short piece on hypocrisy.

notes.q: 人面原不如那纸制底面具哟
notes.zh: 开头就把人脸和面具对比，提出出人意料的观点。
notes.en: Opens with a surprising contrast: a real face is worse than a mask.

notes.q: 红的还是红，白的还是白
notes.zh: 重复句式强调面具“不改变”。
notes.en: The repeated pattern stresses that masks never change.

notes.q: 我们要学面具，但不要戴他
notes.zh: 学面具的“真”，不要用面具遮住自己。结尾点题。
notes.en: Learn the mask's honesty, don't hide behind one: the point of the piece.

intro: 一艘大船沉了，“我”和朋友坐在救生船上。大海象征人生：没有人知道方向，但还是要继续划桨。
After a shipwreck, two friends in a lifeboat: the sea stands for life, where you keep rowing without knowing the way.

notes.q: 风狂浪骇底海面
notes.zh: 风浪大的海面象征充满困难和变化的人生。
notes.en: The stormy sea symbolizes a life full of hardship and change.

notes.q: 那要载我们到目的地底船快要歇息去了
notes.zh: 用“歇息”说船沉了，语气平静却很悲凉。
notes.en: “Going to rest” for a sinking ship: calm words for a grim fact.

notes.q: 我们尽管划罢
notes.zh: 全文主旨：不知道方向也要努力。注意“罢”=吧。
notes.en: The message: keep rowing anyway. Note 罢 = 吧.

intro: 妻子希望丈夫做伟大的人，丈夫却愿意像盐一样，默默地让别人受益而不被看见。
His wife wishes he could be something grand; he would rather be like salt: useful and unseen.

notes.q: 你应当作荫，不应当受荫
notes.zh: “作荫”和“受荫”对比：给别人遮阴，而不是享受别人的保护。
notes.en: Give shade, don't just enjoy it.

notes.q: 愿你作无边宝华盖
notes.zh: 后面连用四个“愿你……”，句式相同，气势越来越强。
notes.en: Four “愿你…” lines in a row build a grand, rising rhythm.

notes.q: 我愿做调味底精盐
notes.zh: 把自己比作盐：融化在食物里，让人尝到味道却看不见盐。
notes.en: He compares himself to salt: it disappears into food but gives the flavour.

notes.q: 盐底功用，若只在调味，那就不配称为盐了
notes.zh: 盐还能防腐、保护，象征更深的奉献。
notes.en: Salt also preserves: a deeper kind of service.

intro: 一家人过“收获节”，父亲借花生教孩子：要做有用的人，不要只做外表好看的人。中学课本名篇。
At a family harvest night, the father uses peanuts to teach: be useful, not showy. A classic textbook piece.

notes.q: 买种底买种，动土底动土，灌园底灌园
notes.zh: 三个相同结构的短语，写出大家分工忙碌、很开心的样子。
notes.en: Three parallel phrases show everyone busy and happy.

notes.q: 这小小的豆不像那好看的苹果、桃子、石榴
notes.zh: 花生和挂在枝上的漂亮水果对比，突出花生不炫耀。
notes.en: Peanuts versus showy fruit on the branch.

notes.q: 所以你们要像花生
notes.zh: 从花生说到做人，是全文的中心。
notes.en: From peanuts to people: the centre of the essay.

notes.q: 父亲底话现在还印在我心版上
notes.zh: 把心比作可以“印”字的版，说明话记得很深。
notes.en: The heart is a printing block his words are pressed into.

intro: 作者感叹时间匆匆流逝，一去不回。全文用很多比喻和排比，节奏像诗。
On time slipping away and never returning. Full of images and parallel lines, almost a poem.

notes.q: 燕子去了，有再来的时候；杨柳枯了，有再青的时候；桃花谢了，有再开的时候。
notes.zh: 三个相同的句子，说自然界的东西能回来，引出“日子却回不来”。
notes.en: Three parallel lines: nature returns, which sets up the contrast that our days don't.

notes.q: 我们的日子为什么一去不复返呢？
notes.zh: 作者提出问题，引发读者思考。
notes.en: A question that draws the reader in.

notes.q: 像针尖上一滴水滴在大海里
notes.zh: 把自己的日子比作大海里的一滴水，又小又没有声音。
notes.en: His days are a drop of water from a needle tip into the sea.

notes.q: 洗手的时候，日子从水盆里过去；吃饭的时候，日子从饭碗里过去
notes.zh: 把“日子”写成会走的人，从生活小事中溜走。
notes.en: Days are personified, slipping past during everyday moments.

intro: 春天的山林里，孩子们在桃花下玩耍。作者用拟人的手法写出春光让万物都“醉”了。
Children play under peach blossoms in spring hills; nature itself seems drunk on spring.

notes.q: 桃花听得入神，禁不住落了几点粉泪
notes.zh: 桃花像人一样“听”鸟唱歌，感动得“流泪”，其实是花瓣落下。
notes.en: The peach blossoms listen and shed “pink tears”: falling petals.

notes.q: 小草花听得大醉
notes.zh: 小花“醉”了，随风摇摆。
notes.en: Little flowers sway as if drunk.

notes.q: 漫游底薄云还是从这峰飞过那峰
notes.zh: 结尾重复开头的画面，春光依旧。
notes.en: The ending repeats an opening image: spring goes on.

intro: 朱自清写春天的到来：春草、春花、春风、春雨和人们。语言清新，有很多比喻、拟人和叠词，是写景的范文。
Spring arrives: grass, flowers, wind, rain and people. Fresh language full of images; a model of descriptive writing.

notes.q: 盼望着，盼望着
notes.zh: 重复表达等春天的急切心情。
notes.en: Repetition shows how eagerly spring is awaited.

notes.q: 春天的脚步近了
notes.zh: 春天像人一样走过来。
notes.en: Spring walks closer like a person.

notes.q: 小草偷偷地从土里钻出来，嫩嫩的，绿绿的
notes.zh: “偷偷地”是拟人，“嫩嫩的，绿绿的”是叠词，写出小草可爱。
notes.en: Personification plus doubled adjectives make the grass lively and sweet.

notes.q: 红的像火，粉的像霞，白的像雪
notes.zh: 三个比喻排在一起（也是排比），写花的颜色。
notes.en: Three similes in a row for the flowers' colours.

notes.q: 春天像刚落地的娃娃
notes.zh: 结尾三段都用“春天像……”，把春天比作娃娃、小姑娘、青年。
notes.en: The last three paragraphs compare spring to a baby, a girl and a young man.

intro: 选自《温州的踪迹》。作者第二次游梅雨潭，被潭水的绿深深吸引，用大量比喻写“绿”。
From 'Traces of Wenzhou': the writer is captivated by the green of Meiyu Pool and describes it with image after image.

notes.q: 我第二次到仙岩的时候，我惊诧于梅雨潭的绿了。
notes.zh: 开头一句，结尾又重复一次，突出“绿”给人的震撼。
notes.en: The first line returns at the end, framing the essay.

notes.q: 像少妇拖著的裙幅
notes.zh: 把潭水轻轻的波纹比作裙子。
notes.en: The water's ripples are like a trailing skirt.

notes.q: 女儿绿
notes.zh: 给绿色起名“女儿绿”，像对待心爱的人。
notes.en: He names the colour “daughter green”, as if it were someone he loves.

intro: 作者回忆父亲在车站送他、为他买橘子的背影。语言朴素，感情深沉，写父爱的名篇。
The writer remembers his father's back as he climbed to buy oranges at the station: a plain, deeply moving piece about a father's love.

notes.q: 我最不能忘记的是他的背影
notes.zh: 开头点题，结尾又写在泪光中看见背影。
notes.en: Names the subject at the start and returns to it at the end.

notes.q: 两脚再向上缩
notes.zh: “攀、缩、倾”等动作写出胖胖的父亲爬月台的吃力，表现父爱。
notes.en: Exact verbs show how hard the climb was for the heavy father.

notes.q: 我的泪很快地流下来了
notes.zh: 简单的一句话，写出儿子的感动。
notes.en: A plain sentence carries the son's emotion.

notes.q: 不相见已二年馀了
notes.zh: “馀”=余，二年馀=两年多。
notes.en: 馀 = 余: more than two years.

intro: 一对夫妻之间的小情趣：兰花的香，还是妻子的香？用对话写出温馨的生活。
A playful moment between husband and wife over the scent of orchids, told mostly in dialogue.

notes.q: 到底是兰花底香，是你底香？
notes.zh: 妻子把丈夫的问题原样问回去，俏皮又亲密。
notes.en: She repeats his question back to him: teasing and affectionate.

intro: 作者心里不宁静，夜里独自去荷塘散步。月光下的荷塘写得极美，也透出淡淡的忧愁。写景名篇。
Restless one night, the writer walks to the lotus pond. Beautiful moonlit description with a quiet sadness underneath.

notes.q: 这几天心里颇不宁静。
notes.zh: 第一句就是全文的情感基调。
notes.en: The first sentence sets the mood of the whole essay.

notes.q: 曲曲折折的荷塘上面，弥望的是田田的叶子
notes.zh: “曲曲折折”“田田”等叠词让语言有音乐感。
notes.en: Doubled words give the line a musical feel.

notes.q: 像亭亭的舞女的裙
notes.zh: 把荷叶比作舞女的裙子。
notes.en: Lotus leaves are compared to a dancer's skirt.

notes.q: 仿佛远处高楼上渺茫的歌声似的
notes.zh: 把闻到的花香写成听到的歌声，是著名的通感句。
notes.en: Smell described as faint distant singing: a famous synesthesia.

notes.q: 但热闹是它们的，我什么也没有
notes.zh: 蝉和蛙的热闹与作者的孤独对比。
notes.en: The noisy frogs and cicadas against his loneliness.

intro: 鲁迅对比江南温柔的雪和北方孤独、飞舞的雪，借雪表达自己的精神。语言难，属于《野草》。
Lu Xun contrasts the soft snow of the south with the lonely, whirling snow of the north. From 'Wild Grass'; difficult language.

notes.q: 是极壮健的处子的皮肤
notes.zh: 把江南的雪比作年轻健康的皮肤，写它滋润、美丽。
notes.en: Southern snow is compared to young, healthy skin.

notes.q: 是死掉的雨，是雨的精魂
notes.zh: 北方的雪象征孤独而坚强的精神。
notes.en: The northern snow stands for a lonely, defiant spirit.

intro: 秋夜里，鲁迅看着后园的枣树和天空。枣树象征坚强的战斗者。属于《野草》，语言难。
On an autumn night Lu Xun looks at the jujube trees and the sky; the trees stand for a fighter. From 'Wild Grass'.

notes.q: 一株是枣树，还有一株也是枣树
notes.zh: 非常有名的一句。故意不说“两株都是枣树”，给人孤单、单调的感觉。
notes.en: Famous line: instead of “both are jujubes”, the slow repetition feels lonely and stark.

notes.q: 奇怪而高
notes.zh: 天空被写得像一个冷漠的人。
notes.en: The sky is written like a cold, distant person.

intro: 鲁迅回忆小时候毁掉弟弟的风筝，长大后才明白自己错了，想道歉却已经没有机会。
Lu Xun remembers destroying his little brother's kite, and realizing too late that he was wrong.

notes.q: 北京的冬季，地上还有积雪
notes.zh: 北京冬天的灰暗和回忆中故乡春天的风筝对比。
notes.en: Beijing's grey winter against the bright kites of home in spring.

notes.q: 精神的虐杀
notes.zh: 作者用很重的词批评自己，表达深深的悔恨。
notes.en: He uses a harsh phrase on himself: deep regret.

intro: 作者在昏暗的夜里打盹，梦见一个美丽的故事，醒来故事却碎了。美好与现实的对比。
Dozing on a dim night, he dreams a lovely story that shatters when he wakes.

notes.q: 我在朦胧中，看见一个好的故事。
notes.zh: 昏暗的现实和美丽的梦形成对比。
notes.en: The dim present against the beautiful dream.

intro: 鲁迅回忆童年：百草园里自由快乐，三味书屋里读书严肃。前后对比，写出童年的乐趣。
Lu Xun's childhood: freedom in the Hundred-Herb Garden, discipline at the Three-Flavour Study.

notes.q: 不必说碧绿的菜畦，光滑的石井栏，高大的皂荚树，紫红的桑椹
notes.zh: 一连串“形容词+名词”，写出百草园景物丰富。
notes.en: A run of adjective + noun pairs shows how rich the garden was.

notes.q: 三味书屋
notes.zh: 后半部分写书屋的严肃，和百草园的自由对比。
notes.en: The strict study in the second half contrasts with the free garden.

intro: 鲁迅在日本学医时的老师藤野先生认真、正直、没有民族偏见。文章也写了鲁迅弃医从文的原因。
Lu Xun's anatomy teacher in Japan: earnest, fair, free of prejudice. Also explains why Lu Xun left medicine for writing.

notes.q: 东京也无非是这样。
notes.zh: 第一句带着失望和讽刺的语气。
notes.en: The first line carries disappointment and irony.

intro: 朱自清和俞平伯夜游秦淮河，写灯光、桨声、水波和复杂的心情。很长、很难，适合挑战。
Zhu Ziqing and a friend take a night boat on the Qinhuai River: lights, oars, water, and mixed feelings. Long and hard: a challenge read.

notes.q: 一九二三年八月的一晚，我和平伯同游秦淮河
notes.zh: 开头交代时间、人物、地点。
notes.en: Opens with time, people and place.
